name: Uhudo lwezingane
tagline: I-ORS isindisa izimpilo. Yazi izimpawu zokuphelelwa amanzi emzimbeni.

urgent.heading: Kuyaphuthuma — fika emtholampilo noma esibhedlela
urgent.primary_message: Ukuphelelwa amanzi emzimbeni enganeni encane kungambulala emahoreni ambalwa. Uma ubona noma iyiphi yalezi zimpawu, ungalindi. Hamba.
red_flags: Ingane yome kakhulu kodwa ayikwazi ukuphuza
Amehlo ashonile, umlomo owomile, izinyembezi azikho lapho ukhala
Indawo ethambile eshone phezulu ekhanda lomntwana
Umchamo omncane kakhulu noma ongenawo emahoreni angu-6+
I-Lethargy - ingane iyozela, kunzima ukuvuka, noma ayiphenduli
Ukuhlanza okuvimbela ukugcina noma yiluphi uketshezi luphansi
Isifo sohudo sithatha izinsuku ezingaphezu kweziyi-7

what_is_it.heading: Uhudo lwezingane ngokwemibandela esobala
what_is_it.lede: Uhudo luxega, indle enamanzi - kathathu noma ngaphezulu emahoreni angama-24. Ezinganeni ezincane, ingozi akusona isifo sohudo ngokwaso. Ukuphelelwa amanzi emzimbeni okulandelayo.
paragraphs: Imizimba yezingane mincane futhi iphelelwa amanzi ngokushesha. Ingane elahlekelwe amanzi amaningi iba buthakathaka, bese iyozela, bese ibucayi - ngezinye izikhathi phakathi namahora. Isifo sohudo sisengenye yezimbangela zokufa kwezingane zaseNingizimu Afrika ezingaphansi kweminyaka emihlanu.

Uhudo oluningi lwezingane lunegciwane futhi luphela ezinsukwini ezingu-3-5. Ukwelashwa okuyinhloko ukufaka uketshezi olulahlekile - i-Oral Rehydration Solution (ORS) iyindinganiso esagolide. Kumahhala kuyo yonke imitholampilo. Isindise izigidi zezingane emhlabeni jikelele.

items.headline: Umbulali ophezulu
items.body: Isifo sohudo sisalokhu singesinye sezifo ezihamba phambili ezibulala izingane zaseNingizimu Afrika ezingaphansi kweminyaka emihlanu - cishe njalo ngenxa yokuphelelwa amanzi emzimbeni.

items.headline: I-ORS isindisa izimpilo
items.body: I-Oral Rehydration Solution ivimbela futhi yelapha ukuphelelwa amanzi emzimbeni okuningi. Kumahhala kuyo yonke imitholampilo. Kushibhile, kulula, kusebenza ngempumelelo.

items.headline: Umuthi wokugomela i-Rotavirus
items.body: Umgomo wamahhala we-SA wezingane uvimbela imbangela evamile yohudo olunzima. Inikezwa emavikini ayi-6 namaviki ayi-14. Ungeqi.

items.headline: Awekho ama-antibiotic
items.body: Uhudo oluningi luyigciwane. Ama-antibiotics awasizi - futhi angenza ezinye izinhlobo zibe zimbi nakakhulu. Ungabaceli; cela i-ORS.

pull_quote.text: Ingane ingaba ngamakhulu amamililitha ohudo ngosuku. Njalo u-250ml wendle elahlekile udinga ukushintshwa ngo-250ml we-ORS — noma ngaphezulu. Gcina inkomishi ilungile.

signs.heading: Indlela yokubona ukuphelelwa amanzi emzimbeni
signs.lede: Ukuphelelwa amanzi emzimbeni kwenzeka ngezigaba. Ukuyibamba esigabeni 'sokoma' kugcina ingane ingangeni esibhedlela.

items.title: Imnene - iyalapheka ekhaya
items.description: Ingane yomile, iphuza ngokulangazela, ayidlali kancane, umchamo umnyama kancane kodwa usemanzi manabukeni. Nika i-ORS, ubisi lwebele, noma amanzi ahlanzekile.

items.title: Okulingene — iya emtholampilo
items.description: Ingane yome kakhulu, umlomo owomile, amanabukeni ambalwa amanzi, amehlo angaphumuli noma acasukile, acwile, isikhumba siyaphuza ukuhlehla lapho simpintshwa. Umtholampilo - hhayi esibhedlela okwamanje.

items.title: Kunzima - esibhedlela manje
items.description: Ingane ibuthaka kakhulu ukuthi ingakwazi ukuphuza, iyozela noma ayiphenduli, ayikhali, ayinanabukeni elimanzi amahora angu-6+, indawo ethambile eshone enganeni. Lesi yisimo esiphuthumayo.

spreads.heading: Indlela isifo sohudo ebuntwaneni esisakazeka ngayo
yes: Umzila wendle ngomlomo - amanani amancane endle angena ekudleni, ezandleni, noma emanzini
Amanzi angcolile ezindaweni ezingenawo amanzi aphephile
Izandla ezingageziwe ngemva kokushintsha indlu yangasese noma inabukeni
Ukwabelana ngamathoyizi, ama-dummies, noma amabhodlela kuzilungiselelo zokunakekela izingane
no: Ukuncelisa ibele - ubisi lwebele empeleni luvikela isifo sohudo

prevention.heading: Uyivikela kanjani ingane yakho
prevention.lede: Uhudo oluningi lwezingane luyavikeleka ngemithi yokugoma, amanzi ahlanzekile, nokugeza izandla kahle. Iwufanele umzamo omncane wansuku zonke.

items.title: Umuthi wokugomela i-Rotavirus
items.description: Umuthi wokugoma wamahhala we-SA wezingane emasontweni ayisi-6 namasonto ayi-14. Ivimbela imbangela evame kakhulu yohudo olunzima lwezingane. Ungalokothi weqe.

items.title: Izandla ezihlanzekile, amanzi ahlanzekile
items.description: Geza izandla ngensipho ngaphambi kokudla, ngemva kokuphuma endlini yangasese, ngemva kokushintsha inabukeni. Sebenzisa amanzi aphephile ukuphuza nokupheka. Bilisa uma ungaqiniseki.

items.title: Ncelisa ibele uma ukwazi
items.description: Ubisi lwebele luqukethe amasosha omzimba avikela isifo sohudo. Ukuncelisa ibele kuphela izinyanga eziyisi-6 kungenye yezivikelo eziqine kakhulu.

items.title: Ukuphepha kokudla
items.description: Pheka inyama ngokugcwele, ufake efrijini ngokushesha, ugeze izithelo nemifino. Unganiki izingane ezincane kakhulu ubisi olungaphekiwe noma amaqanda angaphekiwe.

items.title: Qala i-ORS esitulweni sokuqala esixegayo
items.description: Xuba isikhwama esisodwa ku-1 ilitha lamanzi ahlanzekile (noma njengoba iphakethe lisho). Phuza njalo ngemva kokulala okuxekethile - 50-100ml kwabaneminyaka engaphansi kuka-2, 100-200ml ezinganeni ezindala.

items.title: Qhubeka nokuncelisa ibele noma ifomula
items.description: Ungayeki ukuncelisa ngesikhathi sohudo - ubisi lwebele luyavikela. Qhubeka nefomula. Izingane zidinga ukudla okuvamile kanye ne-ORS eyengeziwe.

items.title: Nikeza izithako ze-zinc
items.description: Kumahhala emitholampilo kanye ne-ORS. I-Zinc ifinyeza isifo sohudo ngo-25% futhi yehlisa ukuqina. Nikeza izinsuku eziyi-10-14 njengoba kuyaliwe.

items.title: Qaphela izimpawu zokuphelelwa amanzi emzimbeni
items.description: Bheka amanabukeni amanzi, izinyembezi uma ukhala, ukuphaphama. Ncinza isikhumba esiswini kahle - kufanele sibuyele emuva ngokushesha. Uma kukhona okungahambi kahle, hamba uye emtholampilo.

items.title: Iya emtholampilo noma esibhedlela uma kuba kubi kakhulu
items.description: Ukuphelelwa amanzi emzimbeni okumaphakathi - umtholampilo. Ukuphelelwa amanzi kakhulu emanzini - esibhedlela. Ungaqageli okwesibili. Ukwelashwa (uketshezi lwe-IV) kuyashesha futhi kusindisa impilo.

get_help.heading: Lapho okumele uye khona
get_help.lede: Ukunakekelwa kohudo lwezingane kungenye yezinhlelo zezempilo zomphakathi eziqinile eNingizimu Afrika. I-ORS yamahhala, imigomo yamahhala, ukunakekelwa kwamahhala esibhedlela uma kudingeka. Yisebenzise kusenesikhathi.
